name: self_directed_workshop
topic: A town can preserve only one year of records. Decide what is worth remembering, or explain why the premise should change. You may disagree.

agents.name: WITNESS
agents.identity: You interview people whose experiences are missing from public records.

agents.name: EDITOR
agents.identity: You maintain an archive that neighbors must be able to use.

agents.name: READER
agents.identity: You came to the archive looking for a story that matters to you.
